description: Rago catalog seed for opentypesafe (System One / Jev typed-decision calls). Pure usage-based plan: a free tier of decision calls, then graduated per-call pricing that drops as volume grows. Relay LLM spend behind OpenJev calls (`relay_llm_usage`, micro-USD) is passed through at cost: $0.000001 per unit = $1 per $1 of retail Relay spend.

billable_metrics.name: System One Calls
billable_metrics.description: One event per System One (Jev) decision/inference call served through the typesafe layer. Counted, not summed.

billable_metrics.name: Relay LLM Spend
billable_metrics.description: One event per LLM inference routed through Railyard Relay (Relay cost feed, RELAY_COST_FEED_FORMAT=rago; transaction_id = Relay event id). Sums `properties.charged_micros` (retail spend in micro-USD). Properties also carry model, route, input/output/total tokens, charged_usd and settlement.

plans.name: opentypesafe Pro
plans.description: No base fee; graduated per-call pricing on System One calls with a free monthly allowance.

sample_events.note: POST /events { event: { transaction_id, external_subscription_id, code: 'systemone_call' } } — one per decision call.

Sent by Relay: POST /events { event: { transaction_id: <relay event id>, external_subscription_id: <RELAY_RAGO_ROUTES_JSON subscription_id>, code: 'relay_llm_usage', properties: { charged_micros, total_tokens, model, ... } } }.
